scope: Initial researched batch of independent and distinctive bars. Listings must have an official website or direct OpenTable listing and a currently sourced rating of at least 4.0/5. Santa Marta listings added October 2026 show one business per tier; tier labels are sample placements for layout testing and do not imply that a business purchased or endorsed a paid listing.
